how: Recruitment asks members to help make an already-started cat and identifies placed pixels.
Perceived community size motivates proposing a smaller design.
Capacity-driven scaling does not establish that defenders stopped fighting or completed relocation while repair and reuse remain alternatives.

Recruitment followed by a cheer cannot test the proposed call-and-bare-acceptance mechanism.

Pending permission reveals neither an agreement nor a stated limit on a representative's mandate under the revised arrow's bound.
Warnings against vandalism state restraint but leave an exchange arguing whether covering is fair unobserved.

Attributions to the void and griefers identify no quarrel imported from before the canvas.

A belief that moderators removed an obscene alteration does not establish an argument over offense, slurs, or hate symbols.
Standalone false unlocks and updates use April Fools licence while a prankster explicitly limits cruelty.
Banner and flair changes elicit enjoyment, fatigue, and avoidance before the moderator acknowledges the prank and its spam.
Fictional commandments are enforced through real removals and approvals, materially affecting ordinary help and daily posts.
Members perform inverted unit evaluations and adapt sincere questions or resubmissions to the joke's title filter.
The host's general title-tag rule removes a canvas-location post without specifically disowning the canvas effort.
Canvas-post removal does not demonstrate flood-driven containment when ordinary posts already face tag sanctions and the moderator attributes spam to the prank.
Avoiding the subreddit because of prank chaos does not establish retaliatory destruction of the room's canvas mark.

Celebration can mark completed achievement retrospectively even after the work no longer stands.
The progress post is answered by a celebration that explicitly recalls making and then losing the cat.
The same celebration records destruction as part of the work's remembered accomplishment.
Celebration and a report of destruction coexist in one turn, which cannot establish a separate ritual-to-archive causal sequence.
Ongoing drawing suggestions and a prank banner do not establish carrying the canvas effort into a later venue, institution, or emblem.
Recorded loss and an ongoing drawing proposal do not establish remembrance causing a legacy decision.
Post-close comments about regaining a spot and darkening a picture identify neither a shared archival copy nor contested historical representation.
Recruiting help for a cat does not establish the finished mark bringing visitors or returning members into the host room.
Game-character suggestions do not establish outreach to creators, teams, companies, streamers, or press about the canvas work.
One member reports altering a clown as a joke without establishing the room's adoption of that act as a campaign.
